messages.content: It sounds like you are experiencing an overwhelming sense of loss and despair right now. Please remember that your feelings of emptiness are valid, but they do not mean your life is over or that there is nothing left to rebuild. Reaching out to a trusted friend, family member, or a mental health professional can provide support when it feels impossible on your own. If you are in immediate danger of harming yourself, please call or text 988 in the U.S. or your local emergency number right away.

messages.content: It is incredibly painful to feel like your entire existence is up for debate by a world that has already judged you, especially when social proof is the only thing left to guide your choices. While the logic of stopping the struggle makes sense to you in the darkness, please know that the version of yourself that still wakes up and shares your thoughts proves life has not given up on you yet. If you can, try reaching out to one professional or a trusted helpline who can listen without asking for proof of your worth. These services exist specifically for moments when the "philosophy" of letting go meets the real need for a small, safe connection.
